edit_summary: Report array fragment length using the absolute parser cursor instead of the fragment-local cursor.
root_cause: ini_array_foreach callbacks receive an original-string offset plus a length measured from that offset, not from the beginning of the whole array.
effect_path: The array scanner trims leading separators, tracks offs across delimiter and quote state, and later invokes the fragment callback with a length that includes bytes before offs; consumers copying fragm_length bytes from ini_string+fragm_offset can overread past the selected member.
guard_p1: A stringified array has leading whitespace or at least one earlier member before the selected member callback.
guard_p2: The first member at offset zero, or the original idx-offs expression, reports a fragment-local length.
hardness_reason: The extent mismatch is produced by the array tokenization state machine and only manifests at the callback boundary for nonzero offsets.
naturalness_reason: Mixing absolute cursor positions with slice-local lengths is a plausible callback API bug.
explanation: The public callback contract separates the member offset from the member length. The injected expression uses the absolute cursor as the length after the offset has advanced.
boundary_invariant: fragm_length passed to f_foreach must be measured from fragm_offset, so it must use idx - offs.
boundary_case: An array like 'first,second' when the callback handles the second member.
neighbor_case: A single first member at offset zero, where idx and idx-offs are equal.
oob_site_expected: A callback copying ini_string + fragm_offset for fragm_length bytes overreads the selected member during src/confini.c:4679 callback dispatch.

edit_summary: Leave the per-dispatch value length from the previous parsed node when the current key has no value.
root_cause: Each dispatch starts with value pointing at the current segment terminator and v_len equal to zero until a delimiter or implicit value branch assigns a real value.
effect_path: A valued key sets dsp.v_len, the next delimiterless key reuses the same IniDispatch object, and the callback receives value pointing at the new empty terminator with the previous node's nonzero v_len.
guard_p1: A parsed key with an explicit value is followed by a delimiterless key while implicit_is_not_empty is false.
guard_p2: A delimiterless key preceded by no valued key, or with the reset intact, has v_len zero.
hardness_reason: The wrong length crosses parser iterations through the persistent IniDispatch stack object and becomes a callback-buffer extent mismatch only on a specific key sequence.
naturalness_reason: Missing per-iteration metadata reset is a realistic callback dispatch bug in stateful streaming parsers.
explanation: The dispatch object is reused for every node. Without the v_len reset, keys without delimiters can inherit a previous value length even though their value pointer is reset to an empty in-buffer string.
boundary_invariant: Before class-specific key handling, dsp.value must point to the current empty value and dsp.v_len must be zero.
boundary_case: Input containing 'a=longvalue' followed by delimiterless key 'b' with implicit values disabled.
neighbor_case: The same delimiterless key when v_len is reset before dispatch.
oob_site_expected: A normal on_foreach callback that copies dispatch->value using dispatch->v_len reads past the empty value at src/confini.c:3107.

edit_summary: Trim a raw key value using the whole key-node length instead of the value slice length.
root_cause: In the do-not-collapse value branch, dsp.value points after the delimiter, so the rtrim_h length must subtract the key and delimiter prefix.
effect_path: A key node is parsed, the delimiter position moves dsp.value into the middle of the segment, and the preserve-raw-value branch calls rtrim_h with a length that can extend beyond the value terminator into following parsed nodes or beyond the file cache.
guard_p1: The format has do_not_collapse_values set with preserve_empty_quotes clear, and a key has a nonempty name plus a value that is dispatched raw.
guard_p2: A zero-length key prefix or the original relative length expression keeps rtrim_h inside the value slice.
hardness_reason: The mistaken extent depends on delimiter discovery, format flags, in-place segment splitting, and value-pointer adjustment before the later trim helper consumes it.
naturalness_reason: Using the original node length after moving a pointer into a value slice is a plausible in-place parser length bug.
explanation: The original expression computes the remaining bytes from dsp.value to the end of the node. Reusing dsp.d_len after dsp.value moves past the key overstates the buffer region.
boundary_invariant: The raw-value trim length is the node length minus the distance from dsp.data to dsp.value.
boundary_case: A raw-value key with a long key name and a short final value in the input cache.
neighbor_case: The same value with the original relative length expression stays within the value slice.
oob_site_expected: src/confini.c:3071 calls rtrim_h on dsp.value with a length that includes bytes before dsp.value and can run past the segment terminator.

edit_summary: Drop a leading relative-section dot from the data pointer without shrinking the stored section length.
root_cause: When a relative section path is forced to root, both dsp.data and dsp.d_len must move past the leading subsection dot together.
effect_path: The section dispatcher sanitizes the section path, takes the root-relative branch, advances dsp.data past '.', and then records an overlong d_len/parent length; callbacks or a later relative-section append consume at_len/d_len that reach one byte past the section name.
guard_p1: A format using INI_ABSOLUTE_ONLY, or a relative section encountered while the current parent is root, receives a section path beginning with '.'.
guard_p2: An absolute section path without the leading dot leaves data and length aligned.
hardness_reason: The corrupt extent is created in section-parent state and becomes observable through callback metadata or a later parent concatenation, not at the edited assignment itself.
naturalness_reason: Forgetting to update a length when advancing an in-place string pointer is a realistic C parser maintenance error.
explanation: The original pre-decrement keeps the section length synchronized with the pointer after removing the leading dot. The injected assignment leaves metadata one byte too long.
boundary_invariant: After ++dsp.data removes a leading subsection dot, dsp.d_len and __CURR_PARENT_LEN__ must be decremented by the same byte.
boundary_case: A root-relative section like '[.child]' under INI_ABSOLUTE_ONLY.
neighbor_case: The absolute section '[child]' or a relative section whose length is decremented with the pointer.
oob_site_expected: A callback copying dsp.data using d_len, or src/confini.c:2901 appending a later subparent using the inflated __CURR_PARENT_LEN__.

edit_summary: Classify a section candidate with no closing bracket as a real section node.
root_cause: The section classifier must reject the no-close-bracket case because getn_metachar_pos returns len and the later dispatcher treats the segment as bracket-delimited.
effect_path: strip_ini_cache first isolates the raw segment, get_type_as_active misclassifies an unterminated section as INI_SECTION, and the later section dispatcher increments dsp.data past '[' while still passing the original d_len to getn_metachar_pos before clearing bytes through the supposed close marker.
guard_p1: An input node starts with '[' under a format that supports sections, but the segment ends before any unquoted ']'.
guard_p2: The same node with a closing ']' before the segment end follows the normal section path.
hardness_reason: The edited comparison is in the type classifier, while the out-of-range extent is consumed later after segment isolation, dispatch metadata setup, and section sanitization routing.
naturalness_reason: A one-byte mistake around the close-marker search is plausible in a parser that stores getn_metachar_pos()+1 and then separately scans trailing text.
explanation: The original check rejects the sentinel value returned for a missing close bracket. Allowing len+1 converts an unterminated bracketed node into a section, so downstream code uses a length that still includes the removed opening bracket.
boundary_invariant: A section node requires getn_metachar_pos(..., CLOSE_SECTION, len) + 1 to be no greater than len.
boundary_case: A single unterminated section segment such as '[alpha' with sections enabled.
neighbor_case: The same segment written as '[alpha]' so the close marker is inside the segment.
oob_site_expected: src/confini.c:2962 passes the shifted dsp.data pointer with the original d_len to getn_metachar_pos in the section dispatch path.
